idea-plugin.name: GitLab MR
idea-plugin.description:
View and manage GitLab Merge Requests directly within IntelliJ IDEA. Supports listing, filtering, creating, merging, and closing MRs without leaving the IDE.

在 IntelliJ IDEA 中直接查看和管理 GitLab 合并请求，无需切换到浏览器。

Features

  • MR List — Filter by state (opened/closed/merged/locked), scope (all/created_by_me/assigned_to_me), and keyword search
  • MR Details — View overview and changed files with native IntelliJ diff viewer
  • MR Actions — Create, merge, close, and delete merge requests directly from IDE
  • Branch Support — Auto-detect project from Git remote; create MR from current branch
  • Multi-instance — Configure multiple GitLab servers (global or per-project scope)

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 or later
  • GitLab account with personal access token (requires api scope)

功能特点

  • MR 列表 — 支持按状态（待合并/已关闭/已合并/有冲突）、范围（全部/我创建的/指派给我的）筛选，支持关键词搜索
  • MR 详情 — 查看合并请求概览和变更文件列表，支持原生 IntelliJ Diff 查看变更内容
  • MR 操作 — 在 IDE 内创建、合并、关闭和删除合并请求
  • 分支支持 — 自动从 Git 远程地址检测项目，支持从当前分支快速创建 MR
  • 多实例配置 — 支持配置多个 GitLab 服务器，可全局共享或按项目单独配置

运行环境

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 或更高版本
  • GitLab 账户及 Personal Access Token（需 api 权限）
idea-plugin.change-notes:
4.0.0

  • Merge actions are now status-aware: the state line shows why a merge request is blocked (pipeline, conflicts, rebase, approvals, draft, etc.), failures explain the reason, and a running pipeline offers "merge when pipeline succeeds".
  • Merge status polling is faster (3s, up to 10 minutes), and background refreshes keep your scroll position and no longer reload the changed file list.
  • Create MR dialog fills the title as "Merge Request: source → target" and the description with the latest commit of the source branch.
  • MR diffs form a cross-file chain in changes-tree order, and "Jump to Source" works when the changed file exists locally.
  • 合并操作会先判断真实状态：状态栏展示阻塞原因（流水线、冲突、需变基、审批、草稿等），失败时给出具体原因，流水线运行中可设置「流水线通过后自动合并」。
  • 合并状态轮询改为每 3 秒、最长 10 分钟；后台刷新保持当前滚动位置，且不再重复加载变更文件列表。
  • 创建 MR 时自动填充标题「Merge Request：源分支 → 目标分支」与源分支最新提交作为描述。
  • MR 差异按变更树顺序组成跨文件差异链，并支持「Jump to Source」跳转到本地源码。

3.0.3

  • Create MR dialog: source and target branch dropdowns now support keyword filtering — type a keyword and press Enter to narrow the list (case-insensitive contains match), or clear the input and press Enter to show all branches again. Enter in these fields filters the list instead of submitting the dialog.
  • Create MR dialog: the assignee dropdown supports the same keyword filtering and matches both the member's display name and GitLab username.
  • After filtering, the dropdown opens automatically and sizes to the number of results (up to 10 rows, then scrolls); when nothing matches it shows a placeholder item and keeps the keyword.
  • The assignee remains optional and starts empty; pick a member to assign, or leave it empty (or choose "None") to create the MR without an assignee.
  • 创建 MR 弹框：源分支、目标分支支持输入关键字后按回车筛选（忽略大小写、包含匹配），清空输入再回车可恢复全部分支；在这两个输入框中按回车只会筛选，不会误触创建。
  • 创建 MR 弹框：指派人下拉框支持同样的关键字筛选，可匹配成员姓名或 GitLab 用户名。
  • 筛选后下拉弹窗自动展开，高度随结果数量自适应（最多 10 行，超出滚动）；无匹配时显示占位提示并保留已输入的关键字。
  • 指派人仍为可选项且默认留空：从列表中选择成员即指派，留空或选择「无」则创建不带指派人的 MR。

3.0.2

  • Fix plugin marketplace compatibility
  • 修复插件市场兼容性问题

3.0.1

  • Remove upper limit on IDE build version to support IntelliJ 2026.1 and future releases
  • 移除 IDE 版本上限，支持 IntelliJ 2026.1及后续版本
